verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes an extensive documented public REST API (workspace-level API reference with types, paths, request/response examples), a first-class CLI, SDKs (e.g. Python SDK for automation), Databricks Connect for programmatic IDE access, and versioned/migration-tracked APIs (Jobs v2.0, SQL API migration guide) - all clearly documented for driving the platform programmatically, which directly satisfies the AI-native 'documented public API' story. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard openapi.json paths), independent hands-on corroboration of API robustness/breadth beyond first-party docs
